privacy.name: Camera
privacy.usageDescription: Stippl uses the camera so you can take a photo and ask the travel assistant about it — for example, snapping a menu outside a restaurant and asking what is vegetarian. Stippl's payment provider can also read your bank card with the camera at checkout, so you can pay for a stay without typing the long card number; you can always enter the card by hand instead.

privacy.name: Contacts
privacy.usageDescription: Stippl shows which of your contacts are on Stippl, so you can follow them — for example, a friend who already plans trips here. Your contacts are never stored.

privacy.name: LocationWhenInUse
privacy.usageDescription: Stippl uses your location to show where you are on the map, and sends it along with your questions to the AI assistant so it can tell you what's near you, like a lunch spot around the corner. This only happens while the app is open; your location is never collected in the background.

privacy.name: Motion
privacy.usageDescription: Stippl's maps use motion activity to tell whether you are walking or travelling by vehicle, so your position and heading stay accurate on the trip map — for example, keeping the map steady while you are on a train instead of snapping between nearby stops. This is never used for fitness or health tracking.

privacy.name: PhotoLibrary
privacy.usageDescription: Stippl needs access to your photo library so you can choose photos to add to your trip journal and set your profile picture — for example, picking a photo you took in Rome to attach to that day of your itinerary. Only the photos you select are uploaded.

privacy.name: PhotoLibraryAdd
privacy.usageDescription: Stippl saves images to your photo library only when you tap Save or Share — for example, saving the scratch map of countries you have visited, or your eSIM QR code so you can install it later without an internet connection.

privacy.name: UserTracking
privacy.usageDescription: Stippl uses your device's advertising identifier to see which ad or shared link brought you to the app and to show you more relevant travel ads in other apps and websites — for example, eSIM data deals for the country of your next trip. Every feature of Stippl works the same if you decline.
